segments.an3.83:1.3: Idha, bhikkhave, kassako gahapati paṭikacceva [paṭigacceva (sī. pī.)] khettaṃ sukaṭṭhaṃ karoti sumatikataṃ [sumattikataṃ (ka.), ettha matisaddo kaṭṭhakhettassa samīkaraṇasādhane dārubhaṇḍe vattatīti sakkataabhidhānesu āgataṃ. taṃ “matiyā suṭṭhu samīkata”nti aṭṭhakathāya sameti].
segments.an3.83:1.4: Paṭikacceva khettaṃ sukaṭṭhaṃ karitvā sumatikataṃ kālena bījāni patiṭṭhāpeti.
segments.an3.83:1.5: Kālena bījāni patiṭṭhāpetvā samayena udakaṃ abhinetipi apanetipi.
segments.an3.83:1.6: Imāni kho, bhikkhave, tīṇi kassakassa gahapatissa pubbe karaṇīyāni.
segments.an3.83:2.1: “Evamevaṃ kho, bhikkhave, tīṇimāni bhikkhussa pubbe karaṇīyāni.
segments.an3.83:2.4: imāni kho, bhikkhave, tīṇi bhikkhussa pubbe karaṇīyāni.
segments.an3.83:3.2: ‘tibbo no chando bhavissati adhisīlasikkhāsamādāne, tibbo no chando bhavissati adhicittasikkhāsamādāne, tibbo no chando bhavissati adhipaññāsikkhāsamādāne’ti.

lines: Catutthassa paṭhame sammā ādānaṃ gahaṇaṃ samādānanti āha “samādānaṃ vuccati gahaṇa”nti.
Lokiyasīlassa adhisīlabhāvo pariyāyenāti nippariyāyameva taṃ dassetuṃ “apica sabbampi lokiyasīla”ntiādi vuttaṃ.
Pañcapi dasapi vā sīlāni sīlaṃ nāma, pātimokkhasaṃvaro adhisīlaṃ nāma anavasesakāyikacetasikasaṃvarabhāvato maggasīlassa padaṭṭhānabhāvato ca.
Aṭṭha samāpattiyo cittaṃ, vipassanāpādakajjhānaṃ adhicittaṃ maggasamādhissa adhiṭṭhānabhāvato.
Kammassakatañāṇaṃ paññā, vipassanā adhipaññā maggapaññāya adhiṭṭhānabhāvato.
Apica nibbānaṃ patthayantena samādinnaṃ pañcasīlaṃ dasasīlampi adhisīlameva nibbānādhigamassa paccayabhāvato.
Nibbānaṃ patthayantena samāpannā aṭṭha samāpattiyopi adhicittameva.
Evaṃ atīte anāgate ca vaṭṭamūlakadukkhasallakkhaṇavasena saṃvegavatthutāya vimuttiākaṅkhāya paccayabhūtā kammassakatapaññāpi adhipaññāti vadanti.
